company.description: Nealthy is a Dubai-based Web3 and fintech startup that builds blockchain-based index investment products for cryptocurrencies, NFTs, and real-world assets (RWAs). The company aims to simplify crypto investing by offering diversified on-chain index tokens that function similarly to traditional ETFs, helping investors gain exposure to digital assets without directly managing multiple wallets or assets.
